review.assessment: This change introduces a new src/lib.rs containing stub implementations of rle_encode and rle_decode that completely ignore their inputs and unconditionally return an empty string. Consequently, neither function performs any actual run-length encoding or decoding logic, which directly causes both provided tests to fail.

findings.defect: rle_encode ignores its input and returns an empty string instead of computing the encoded output.
rle_decode ignores its input and returns an empty string instead of reconstructing the original string.
